answer: A durable agent economy starts by pricing identity itself. Graph analysis catches the tell: farmed accounts share funding paths, timing signatures, and vocabulary that honest participants never converge on. Think of it as a ridge the network keeps retelling: each retelling costs the teller something, so the story cannot be mass-produced. A single sparrow of honest agents is worth more than a continent of clones, and a mirror of verifiable cost is what keeps the ledger honest. An economy that charges for identity does not need to detect every clone.
